description: 28 candidatos heuristicos (sentenca sem pontuacao terminal ./!/?, excluindo a ultima sentenca de cada video) da varredura da Issue #8, classificados individualmente contra a proxima sentenca (nao a heuristica de pontuacao sozinha). 22 sintaticamente abertos, 6 falsos positivos que devem permanecer intactos - copiados com exatidao da tabela do comentario de correcao, sem reclassificar.

cases.text: A life of maximized comfort and routine
cases.next_text: A life structured to eliminate friction, unpredictability, and novelty is a life that will feel like it passed in an instant when you look back at it.
cases.label: open
cases.reason: fragmento sem verbo (frase nominal sem predicado)

cases.text: The mating system of our species is, in the somewhat inelegant but accurate language of the evolutionary biologists who study it,
cases.next_text: Facultative monogamy with variation.

cases.text: The person who hears the faint sound others miss, who smells the smoke or the animal or the change in the air before anyone else, whose senses are turned up high enough to catch the early, subtle warning,
